product.title: Business Economics Challenge
product.summary: Fourteen timed rounds of business economics under live company metrics.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students lead strategy across fourteen rounds, answering scenario questions on contracts, risk-adjusted return, diversification, moral hazard and capital structure while cash, growth, trust, compliance and risk respond, using three lifelines and a streak multiplier, ending in a board report.

studentDataProfile.notes: State kept in browser localStorage only; no server call observed.

governance.maturityBasis: Complete, documented and publicly reachable. No student-run evidence exists.

health.technicalBasis: Playtested end to end 2026-08-16 with no defects found across twelve-plus rounds. The closing board report is the best diagnostic in the account: a per-concept mastery breakdown across all seven concepts plus a study plan naming what to review. A naive run bled cash to zero by round 12 and ended early, which is a real failure state.
knownBlockers: Framed as a strategy simulation, but every round has one objectively correct answer and an explicit best path — rigorous timed multiple choice rather than a tradeoff space.
On a phone all six stat tiles stack full width, so a student scrolls past seven tiles to reach the question while a 27-second clock runs.

curation.tierBasis: Rigorous timed economics with the best closing diagnostic in the account — per-concept mastery and a study plan naming what to review. Honestly a quiz rather than a strategy space, and worth using as one.

provenance.evidence: 301-M2-ECON/README.md: 'Interactive business simulation game for 9th-10th graders' and '14 rounds'.
openQuestions: The repo's only commit is titled 'Delete 301-M2-ECON directory' while adding every file, suggesting extraction from a former monorepo. Provenance is unresolved.
